text:
lee: heads-up: promo for release `v2026.4` is paused. pack step in CI failed with a checksum mismatch on artifact-store after multipart upload. logs snippet:
```
[13:05:02] twine upload succeeded (200)
[13:05:03] artifact-store verify expected=sha256:deadbeef got=sha256:deadbfff
ERROR: checksum mismatch
```
lee: deploybot shows ARTIFACT_VERIFY_FAIL and promo auto-fallback disabled. @deploybot any extra detail?
deploybot: Promotion paused: ARTIFACT_VERIFY_FAIL. Retry not attempted (reserved release). See build ci/40121.
nina: could be multipart chunk reorder on our S3 proxy. re-run with `--no-cache` or try single-part upload from agent.
lee: runner workspace evicted so reupload from job not possible. i'll trigger a no-cache rerun `bk run 40121 --no-cache`
ci-bot: rerun started (ci/40121#2).
lee: rerun still failing, same checksum. trying single PUT from ephemeral agent now.
lee: single PUT returned 200 but verify still reports different checksum. looks like store is returning different bytes.
release-coordinator: change window ends 13:20 PT. if we can't fix by 13:12 we will pin to last-stable and manual-promote.
lee: opening ticket ART-901 and capturing traces. pinning plan ready.
release-coordinator: decision: pin to `v2026.3` to preserve window. we'll run full investigation after.
deploybot: Manual promote requested for tag `v2026.3` by release-coordinator. Promotion queued.
lee: note for release notes: "Release delayed: artifact-store multipart verification failure; pinned previous release to keep change window. Investigating chunk ordering on S3 proxy."
release-coordinator: thanks team, closing promo thread and moving to incident ART-901 for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
